column1: # Layer 2 — causal readings, one axis per row. Schema for INSTRUMENT.md.
# Two scales: signal_magnitude/input_floor are input (intervention) scale; effect/lower/upper/
# output_resolution/claim_threshold are output scale. Keep them apart.
# reading is assigned by one deterministic precedence, first match wins:
#   1 unresolved      instrument_valid=0, or provenance incomplete, or N below predeclared power
#   2 below_resolution  signal_magnitude < input_floor, OR claim_threshold < output_resolution  (fixed before data)
#   3 detected        lower >= claim_threshold in predicted_direction, valid + sensitive instrument
#   4 contradicted    upper < claim_threshold, sensitive instrument, valid control
#   5 unresolved      interval straddles claim_threshold with no resolution failure (underpowered)
